title: Speaking — Buying second-hand
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on buying second-hand.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
Have you ever bought something second-hand?
What would you look for when choosing a used item?

part2.topic: Describe a useful second-hand item you found or borrowed.
part2.closing: and explain what you gained by choosing it.

questions: What makes people trust a second-hand seller?
How can the purchase of used goods affect manufacturers?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to buying second-hand?
